name: Under the Blood Moon
source:
In this world that has treated you so cruelly, is there a place you can call home? To feel safe? To feel loved?

Ramon Rojo, leader of the Church of Ichor, provides for his congregation. Those who feel lost in this world, abandoned to their fate, victims of the cruel monsters that roam these lands.

But even a man surrounded by a hundred can feel lonely…

In these humble, sacred halls, everyone deserves to feel safe, to be loved. When the Pastor extends his hands to you, promises you safety, salvation, and more importantly, love, will you take his hand? Will you accept what it means…

…To join the Church that sits Under the Blood Moon?

Experience what it means to join the church, through the lens of Tanya Cheong, or your own original character.

Is the church as bad as everyone says it is? Will it become your home? Can you trust them?

[From [url=https://residentrabbit.itch.io/under-the-blood-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个对你如此残酷的世界里，还有一个地方可以称之为家吗？为了感到安全？感受到被爱？

拉蒙·罗霍 (Ramon Rojo)，灵液教会的领袖，为他的会众提供食物。那些在这个世界上感到迷失、被命运抛弃的人，是在这片土地上游荡的残酷怪物的受害者。

但即使是一个被一百人包围的人也会感到孤独……

在这些简陋而神圣的大厅里，每个人都应该感到安全、被爱。当牧师向你伸出双手，向你许诺安全、救赎，更重要的是，爱时，你会握住他的手吗？你能接受这意味着什么吗……

……加入血月下的教会？

通过Tanya Cheong或你自己的原创角色的镜头，体验加入教会的意义。

教会真的像大家说的那么糟糕吗？它会成为你的家吗？你能相信他们吗？

[来自[url=https://residentrabbit.itch.io/under-the-blood-moon]itch.io[/url]]
